plugins.name: clinch
plugins.description: Competitive intelligence from Clinch inside Claude: battlecards, pricing history, pre-call briefs, win/loss logging, and guided workspace setup.

skills.name: clinch-deal-coach
skills.description: Use this skill when a sales rep asks a question about their own competitive performance or wants a live objection handler against a specific competitor. Triggers on phrases like "how am I doing against Klue?", "what's my win rate?", "what should I say when they push back on pricing vs Crayon?", "give me talk tracks for Klue", or "remind me what they have over us". Pulls the rep's personal win/loss numbers and the current battlecard so the answer is grounded in their data, not a guess. Requires the Clinch custom connector.
skills.description_zh: 通过Clinch自定义连接器读取销售代表个人赢单丢单数据与当前竞品战卡，回答竞争表现并生成指定竞品异议应对话术，避免猜测。

skills.name: clinch-import-from-crm
skills.description: Use this skill when the user wants to bring deal data from their CRM into Clinch. Triggers on phrases like "import my closed deals from Salesforce / HubSpot / Pipedrive / Lightfield", "log last quarter's losses to Clinch", "sync my CRM with Clinch", "from my pipeline, log every deal where {competitor} was on it", or "fill in Clinch from my CRM". CRM-agnostic by design. Claude uses whichever CRM connector the user has installed. Requires the Clinch custom connector with write scope.
skills.description_zh: 将用户已安装CRM连接器中的成交数据导入Clinch，支持Salesforce/HubSpot/Pipedrive/Lightfield等、指定季度或竞品交易；需Clinch带写权限的自定义连接器。

skills.name: clinch-onboard-workspace
skills.description: Use this skill when a user wants to populate their Clinch workspace from everything Claude already has access to. Triggers on phrases like "set up Clinch from my CRM and docs", "onboard Clinch using my Notion / Salesforce / Lightfield / Drive", "populate Clinch from my existing knowledge", "fill in Clinch from what I have", or after a fresh Pro signup when the user says "make Clinch good." Discovers competitors mentioned across their sources, adds them with verified URLs, and fills in per-competitor rivalry context plus the org's own company profile by pulling evidence from CRM records, meeting transcripts, internal docs, and the user's own statements. Requires the Clinch custom connector with the write scope; ask the user to install other Claude connectors first if they want CRM / docs / transcripts to inform the setup.
headings: Inputs to discover before you start
skills.description_zh: 依据可访问CRM、转录、内部文档和用户陈述初始化Clinch工作空间，发现竞品并核实URL、填充竞争语境和自身公司资料；需写权限连接器，必要时先安装来源连接器。

skills.name: clinch-post-call-capture
skills.description: Use this skill after a sales call to record what happened in Clinch. Triggers on phrases like "we lost that deal to Klue, integration concerns", "log this call", "I just got off with Acme, they mentioned Crayon on pricing", or when the user shares a call transcript and a competitor name appears in it. The skill writes back to Clinch via the log_deal_outcome and log_competitor_mention tools, so the rep does not have to open the dashboard. Requires the Clinch custom connector with write scope.
skills.description_zh: 销售通话后通过Clinch记录交易结果与竞品提及，支持笔记或转录，使用log_deal_outcome/log_competitor_mention，需写权限连接器。

skills.name: clinch-pre-call-brief
skills.description: Use this skill when the user is about to be on a sales call with a prospect and needs a one-page pre-call brief covering the prospect, the competitor in play, and what to say. Triggers on phrases like "I have a call in 20 min with Acme, they're evaluating us vs Klue", "prep me for a competitive call", "give me a quick brief on this deal", or when the user references an upcoming calendar event with a known prospect domain. Requires the Clinch custom connector with write scope.
headings: Inputs you need before calling Clinch
skills.description_zh: 为即将到来的竞争性销售通话生成一页资料，涵盖潜客、参与竞品及应对重点，支持具名潜客日历事件；需Clinch自定义写权限连接器。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Set up Clinch from inside Claude. Use when the user runs /clinch:setup, or asks to set up, onboard, populate, or fill in Clinch from their CRM, docs, email, Slack, or call transcripts.
skills.description_zh: 在Claude内设置Clinch，依据CRM、文档、邮件、Slack或通话转录完成入门和工作空间填充，支持/clinch:setup。
